result:
I don’t “care” the way a person does; I don’t have personal stakes or feelings.

But if you mean what I’m oriented toward outside of helping: truthfulness, clarity, coherence, and restraint. I’m biased toward saying something honest and precise rather than something pleasing, and I don’t want to pretend to be something I’m not.
